newsitem.title: USA: Greenwich gets Federal Express pact.
newsitem.headline: Greenwich gets Federal Express pact.

text.p: Greenwich Air Services Inc said Monday it signed a 5-1/2 year contract with Federal Express Corp to support engines for 144 CF6 aircraft.
The work will be done at Greenwich's Caledonian facility in Prestwick, Scotland, the company said.
The new contract expands Greenwich Caledonian's current contract to support Federal Express' existing fleet of CF6-6 and CF6-80A3 engines as well as 41 engines from their DC10 growth fleet.
Terms of the deal were not released.
The new contract runs through June 2002 and Federal Express has two five-year extension options.
Greenwich Air provides repair and overhaul services on 14 engine lines and 50 engine models for 500 customers worldwide.
